what_differs: Jira frames the join rule as same Player, Deal and Rep, and the POC flow matches on Player + Deal Rep Assignment. On 9/30 Emily and Kobi agreed a duplicate is the same player and same deal regardless of rep, and that the same player/deal with a different rep is a fraud signal. With the current key, a second rep's click creates a new Sign-Up.
suggested_action: Update WAGR-473 with the 9/30 rule and record Kobi's check of the SLC flow (L3445). If the flow keys on DRA, add a story to match on Player + Deal and flag a different-rep click for review.
